device.name: ARI M1 mirror section (ari_sxn_common, read only)

facts.text: M1 is the ophyd Device for the ARI M1 mirror section and extends DeviceWithLocations
M1 declares the five mirror motor Components Ry_coarse, Ry_fine, Rz, x and y as ID29EpicsMotor
M1 declares vacuum as _VacuumDevices, slits as BaffleSlit and diag as Diagnostic
M1.trigger calls the parent trigger, the slits trigger and the diag trigger, and returns their combined status
ID29EpicsMotor is a subclass of ophyd EpicsMotor
ID29EpicsMotor.__init__ sets the kind of user_setpoint and of user_readback
ID29EpicsSignalRO is a subclass of ophyd EpicsSignalRO
_AriSxnC declares ccg, tcg and ip as ID29EpicsSignalRO and gv as ID29TwoButtonShutter
BaffleSlit declares top, bottom, inboard and outboard as ID29EpicsMotor and currents as ID29EM
Diagnostic declares blade and filter as ID29EpicsMotor, camera as Prosilica and currents as ID29EM
DeviceWithLocations declares locations as a Component of its own LocationSignal
LocationSignal.get evaluates the parent's configured locations and puts the matching flags at read time
BaffleSlit aliases the mean_value of currents.current1 through current4 as top, bottom, inboard and outboard
Diagnostic exposes currents.current1 through current4 and their mean_value members
M1.__init__ renames diag.currents.current1.mean_value to <name>_photocurrent, hints it and exposes it as the photocurrent attribute
ID29EM derives from NSLS_EM, imported from ophyd.quadem
Prosilica combines SingleTrigger, imported from ophyd.areadetector.trigger_mixins, with ProsilicaDetector
ID29EM.__init__ puts 'EM180' into the nd_array_port of current1 to current4 while it is constructed
Diagnostic.trigger reads the camera array counter, then triggers the camera, the currents and the parent and combines their statuses
BaffleSlit.trigger triggers the currents and the parent and combines their statuses
